use_cases: Landing page hero background with dynamic animated visuals
Loading state indicator with radial motion pattern
Decorative accent element for marketing pages
Background animation for SaaS product demos
Visual interest element for entertainment or media platforms
ai_summary: A decorative radial animation component that generates a circular array of dots with staggered color cycling using HSL hues. Each dot animates radially using CSS @keyframes with cubic-bezier timing, creating a pulsating flower-like pattern. The component uses CSS custom properties extensively for dynamic sizing, timing, and positioning, making it a lightweight reusable background effect for landing pages and hero sections.
